blocks.text:
To: Steven Lowe
Cc: Daniel Leach

I am starting this thread so our status and requests on the growth work stay in one place as things move. Where we are: we have the first data pull and the segment revenue history, and I have begun laying out where {{fact:f:E-2009-002.client}} earns today, segment by segment. Daniel Leach has the published market sources going in parallel, so the sizing and the current-position work move together instead of one waiting on the other.

The one gap is the customer-level detail underneath the two largest segments. We can work from the segment totals for now, but the customer cut is what tells us whether the growth there is spread across the base or sitting in a handful of accounts, and that difference changes the whole read. We do not need it by month, only by account for the current year and the two before. If your finance team can send that by the end of next week, we stay on plan.

Nothing else is needed from you today. On our side the next thing is the interviews with the four segment leads; I will send proposed times tomorrow so your assistants can hold the slots. For the record on this thread, Brenda Rodriguez is your point of contact on the analysis and Daniel Leach on the data pulls, so a question always reaches the right desk.
